# proxcenter_vnets (Data Source)

VNets of a vDC; pve_name is the bridge of a proxcenter_vm network block. The token needs a scope that opens GET /api/v1/vdcs/{id}/vnets (vdcs:read, ipam:read, nodes:read or network:write) besides its VM scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_vnets" "prod" {
  vdc_id = data.proxcenter_vdc.prod.id
}

output "vnet_bridges" {
  value = { for v in data.proxcenter_vnets.prod.vnets : v.name => v.pve_name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vdc_id` (String) vDC id (data.proxcenter_vdc.<name>.id).

### Read-Only

- `vnets` (Attributes List) The VNets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vnets))

<a id="nestedatt--vnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vnets`

Read-Only:

- `bridge` (String) Underlying bridge, when any.
- `cidr` (String) Subnet, when the VNet has one.
- `gateway` (String) Subnet gateway.
- `ipam_enabled` (Boolean) Whether ProxCenter allocates the addresses of this subnet.
- `name` (String) Name shown to the tenant.
- `pve_name` (String) Proxmox name of the VNet: the bridge of a network block.
- `tag` (Number) VXLAN VNI or VLAN tag.
- `type` (String) vxlan or vlan.
